decisions.context: Reproducing forecasts for any past week requires knowing which data produced each result. The brief does not prescribe a versioning mechanism.

alternatives.label: Data version repository
pros: Reproducibility: dedicated data versions
cons: Fast iteration: extra repository workflow

alternatives.label: Data versioning in code repository
pros: Reproducibility: versions alongside code
cons: Cost: repository may grow with data

alternatives.label: No data versioning
pros: Fast iteration: no versioning setup
cons: Reproducibility: past inputs unclear

decisions.rationale: Reproducibility decides the choice: a dedicated repository makes past input versions identifiable. This adds a separate workflow for a three-person team.
consequences: Record the data version used for each weekly forecast.
Keep data and code version references together in run records.

decisions.decision: Should forecasting and training use batch or real-time processing?
decisions.context: The system produces weekly demand forecasts. The brief gives no real-time prediction requirement.

alternatives.label: Batch-based data processing
pros: Weekly run: aligns to weekly cadence
Reproducibility: bounded input snapshot
cons: Fast iteration: changes wait for next run

alternatives.label: Real-time, stream-based data processing
pros: Fast iteration: responds to incoming data
cons: Weekly run: extra continuous-processing complexity
Reproducibility: changing inputs are harder to replay

decisions.rationale: The weekly run decides the choice: batch processing fits the stated cadence and makes each run’s inputs easier to reproduce. This gives up immediate processing of new data.
consequences: Run forecasts against a defined weekly data snapshot.
No real-time processing path is established.

decisions.decision: When and how to train the model?
decisions.context: The team needs to bring model ideas into production quickly while maintaining reproducible forecasts. The brief does not describe online learning needs.

alternatives.label: Batch-based learning
pros: Reproducibility: training can use fixed inputs
Weekly run: fits periodic training
cons: Fast iteration: model updates await a training run

alternatives.label: Incremental learning
pros: Fast iteration: updates can be applied incrementally
cons: Reproducibility: evolving model state complicates replay

alternatives.label: Hybrid batch-based and incremental learning
pros: Fast iteration: supports incremental updates
cons: Reproducibility: more moving model state
Weekly run: adds operational complexity

decisions.rationale: Reproducibility decides the choice: batch training can be tied to a fixed data version and run. The trade-off is that new ideas wait for a training cycle before evaluation and release.
consequences: Train from versioned weekly data snapshots.
Record the training inputs and resulting model version.

decisions.decision: How to automate integration and delivery?
decisions.context: A three-person team owns the pipeline end to end, and new model ideas should reach production quickly without breaking the weekly run. The brief does not define a specific deployment process.

alternatives.label: CI/CD pipeline
pros: Fast iteration: automate build and delivery
cons: Weekly run reliability: faulty changes can reach production without gates

alternatives.label: Build and Deployment scripts
pros: Weekly run reliability: team controls deployment timing
cons: Small team: repeated manual release work
Fast iteration: release steps can slow changes

alternatives.label: Machine learning orchestrator
pros: Weekly run reliability: coordinates pipeline components
cons: Small team: added platform and maintenance burden

alternatives.label: No integration or delivery automation
pros: Small team: no automation setup
cons: Fast iteration: manual delivery slows releases
Weekly run reliability: less consistent execution

decisions.rationale: Fast iteration decides the choice: CI/CD automates repeated integration and delivery work. To protect the weekly run, releases need checks and controlled promotion, which add pipeline setup and maintenance.
consequences: Automate repeatable build and delivery steps.
Gate model changes before production promotion.

decisions.context: New model ideas must reach production without breaking the weekly run. The system’s specific forecast quality thresholds are not stated.

alternatives.label: Unit testing feature engineering logic
pros: Reproducibility: catches changed feature calculations
cons: Weekly run reliability: misses failures across components

alternatives.label: Integration testing pipeline components
pros: Weekly run reliability: checks components working together
cons: Fast iteration: broader checks take longer than unit tests

alternatives.label: Testing trained model quality
pros: Weekly run reliability: catches quality regressions
cons: Fast iteration: needs agreed quality thresholds

alternatives.label: No testing
pros: Fast iteration: no test development overhead
cons: Weekly run reliability: regressions may go unnoticed

decisions.rationale: Weekly run reliability decides the choice: integration tests can catch failures across the pipeline before release. They add execution time, and the brief does not supply thresholds for model quality tests.
consequences: Include pipeline integration checks in delivery gates.

decisions.decision: How to monitor the model in production?
decisions.context: The weekly forecasting run must continue to work as new ideas reach production. The brief does not state the production monitoring signals or response process.

alternatives.label: Model performance monitoring
pros: Weekly run reliability: surfaces quality changes
cons: Reproducibility: needs linked run and input records

alternatives.label: Monitoring or logging data and predictions
pros: Reproducibility: records inputs and outputs
cons: Weekly run reliability: logs alone may not detect quality loss

alternatives.label: Model in-production tracking
pros: Reproducibility: tracks model usage and outputs
cons: Small team: broader tracking needs more upkeep

alternatives.label: No in-production monitoring
pros: Small team: no monitoring setup
cons: Weekly run reliability: failures may remain unnoticed

decisions.rationale: Weekly run reliability decides the choice: monitoring model performance can reveal quality changes after release. The brief does not specify metrics, so choosing and maintaining useful measures remains additional work.
consequences: Select forecast quality measures and alert thresholds.
Link monitoring results to model and data versions.
